entities.name: Célia Xakriabá
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Célia Nunes Correa, better known as Célia Xakriabá, is an indigenous educator and activist of the Xakriabá people of Brazil. She is best known for holding debates and lectures at universities in Brazil promoting, among other things, advancement of the status and rights of indigenous women, indigenous land rights, and indigenous education.
